ai_playerbot_boss_ability.ddl:
CREATE TABLE `ai_playerbot_boss_ability` (
  `map` smallint unsigned NOT NULL COMMENT '地图/副本 id',
  `boss_entry` int unsigned NOT NULL COMMENT 'BOSS 本体 entry（召唤物的行也填它所属的 boss）',
  `owner_entry` int unsigned NOT NULL DEFAULT '0' COMMENT '实际施法单位 entry：boss 本体=boss_entry；召唤物/图腾=它自己的 entry',
  `spell_id` int unsigned NOT NULL COMMENT 'spell_template.Id（未匹配到 = 0，靠 note 保留攻略名字）',
  `category` varchar(24) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'other' COMMENT 'heal/control/interrupt/dispel/aoe/move/summon/buff/damage/other',
  `interruptible` tinyint unsigned NOT NULL DEFAULT '0' COMMENT '是否可打断（0/1）',
  `dispellable` varchar(16) NOT NULL DEFAULT '' COMMENT '可驱散类型：magic/disease/curse/poison（空=不可驱散/未知）',
  `avoid_sectors` varchar(32) NOT NULL DEFAULT '' COMMENT '禁站扇区：front/right/back/left（60° 一档，逗号分隔）',
  `facing_mode` varchar(24) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'away_group' COMMENT '朝向模式：away_group/fixed/open/wall',
  `facing_deg` smallint NOT NULL DEFAULT '0' COMMENT 'fixed 模式下的目标朝向（度）',
  `generic_handling` varchar(32) NOT NULL DEFAULT '' COMMENT '交给哪条通用链路（空 = 通用处理不了）',
  `needs_special` tinyint unsigned NOT NULL DEFAULT '0' COMMENT '1 = 需要单独策略',
  `source` enum('guide','db','observed') NOT NULL DEFAULT 'guide' COMMENT '数据来源',
  `note` varchar(255) NOT NULL DEFAULT '' COMMENT '攻略原文/补充说明',
  PRIMARY KEY (`map`,`boss_entry`,`owner_entry`,`spell_id`,`category`),
  KEY `idx_needs_special` (`needs_special`),
  KEY `idx_category` (`category`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci COMMENT='副本 BOSS/召唤物技能与效果，决定"通用处理 or 单独策略"'

CREATE TABLE `ai_playerbot_dungeon_route` (
  `map` smallint unsigned NOT NULL COMMENT '地图/副本 id',
  `guid` int unsigned NOT NULL COMMENT 'creature spawn guid',
  `ord` smallint unsigned NOT NULL DEFAULT '0' COMMENT '波次序：沿细化路径的弧长序，越小越靠前；同组共享同一个值；0 = 未算（只有分组）',
  `group_id` int unsigned NOT NULL DEFAULT '0' COMMENT '静态遭遇组 id（同组一起拉）；0 = 未分组',
  `kind` tinyint unsigned NOT NULL DEFAULT '0' COMMENT '0 = 静态怪；1 = 类型A巡逻怪（路线全在本组领地内，已并入本组）',
  `verified` tinyint unsigned NOT NULL DEFAULT '0' COMMENT '1 = 该图已通过 L3 实测，允许运行时按 ord 驱动；0 = 未验证（运行时完全回落原逻辑）',
  PRIMARY KEY (`map`,`guid`),
  KEY `idx_map_ord` (`map`,`ord`),
  KEY `idx_map_grp` (`map`,`group_id`,`ord`)
) ENGINE=MyISAM DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb3 ROW_FORMAT=DYNAMIC COMMENT='副本推进路线：怪 -> 波次序 + 遭遇组（离线生成，勿手改）'

  `to_z` float NOT NULL DEFAULT '0' COMMENT '终点 高度',
  `dh` float NOT NULL DEFAULT '0' COMMENT '高差 to_z - from_z（跳跃高度上限的实测依据）',
  `dist` float NOT NULL DEFAULT '0' COMMENT '水平距离（跳跃距离上限的实测依据）',
  `payload` varchar(128) NOT NULL DEFAULT '' COMMENT '类型参数，如 gate_entry=182539',
  `sel_name` varchar(64) NOT NULL DEFAULT '' COMMENT '选中目标名字',
  `master_guid` int unsigned NOT NULL DEFAULT '0' COMMENT '标记人 guid',
  `master_name` varchar(32) NOT NULL DEFAULT '' COMMENT '标记人名字',
  `mark` varchar(64) NOT NULL DEFAULT '' COMMENT '备注（.bot trans note）',
  `created_at` int unsigned NOT NULL DEFAULT '0' COMMENT 'unix 时间',
  `sel_kind` char(1) NOT NULL DEFAULT '' COMMENT 'c=生物 / g=游戏物体',
  `sel_guid` int unsigned NOT NULL DEFAULT '0' COMMENT '选中目标 guid',
  `sel_entry` int unsigned NOT NULL DEFAULT '0' COMMENT '选中目标 entry',
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  KEY `idx_map_type` (`map`,`ttype`),
  KEY `idx_map_blocks` (`map`,`from_block`,`to_block`)
) ENGINE=MyISAM DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb3 ROW_FORMAT=DYNAMIC COMMENT='人工标记的跨块转移（.bot trans，勿手改）'

ai_playerbot_patrol.ddl:
CREATE TABLE `ai_playerbot_patrol` (
  `map` smallint unsigned NOT NULL COMMENT '地图/副本 id',
  `guid` int unsigned NOT NULL COMMENT 'creature spawn guid',
  `entry` int unsigned NOT NULL COMMENT 'creature entry',
  `point` smallint unsigned NOT NULL COMMENT '路线点序号，从 0 起',
  `x` float NOT NULL COMMENT '路线点 世界X',
  `y` float NOT NULL COMMENT '路线点 世界Y',
  `z` float NOT NULL COMMENT '路线点 高度',
  `detection` float NOT NULL DEFAULT '18' COMMENT '该怪侦测距离（战斗点安全距离用）',
  `patrol_type` char(1) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'B' COMMENT 'A = 单组巡逻（仅诊断，正常应并入 ①）；B = 跨组/无组巡逻，运行时动态避让，不占 ord',
  PRIMARY KEY (`map`,`guid`,`point`),
  KEY `idx_map_guid` (`map`,`guid`),
  KEY `idx_map_type` (`map`,`patrol_type`)
) ENGINE=MyISAM DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb3 ROW_FORMAT=DYNAMIC COMMENT='巡逻怪及其路线点（离线生成，勿手改）'

ai_playerbot_patrol_wave.ddl:
CREATE TABLE `ai_playerbot_patrol_wave` (
  `map` smallint unsigned NOT NULL COMMENT '地图/副本 id',
  `guid` int unsigned NOT NULL COMMENT '巡逻怪 spawn guid',
  `ord` smallint unsigned NOT NULL COMMENT '会被它撞上的波次（= dungeon_route.ord）',
  `clearance` float NOT NULL DEFAULT '0' COMMENT '路线到该波仇恨圈的最小净距（码）；< 0 = 穿过，越负越深',
  PRIMARY KEY (`map`,`guid`,`ord`),
  KEY `idx_map_ord` (`map`,`ord`)
) ENGINE=MyISAM DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb3 ROW_FORMAT=DYNAMIC COMMENT='类型B 巡逻怪会撞上哪些波（route_v2.py 生成，勿手改）'

ai_playerbot_priority_obs.ddl:
CREATE TABLE `ai_playerbot_priority_obs` (
  `entry` int unsigned NOT NULL COMMENT 'creature_template.entry（怪的类型，不是 guid）',

  `count` int unsigned NOT NULL DEFAULT '0' COMMENT '累计观测到该 entry 读此类条的次数（只增）',
  `last_seen` int unsigned NOT NULL DEFAULT '0' COMMENT '最近一次观测到的 unix 时间',
  `last_map` smallint unsigned NOT NULL DEFAULT '0' COMMENT '最近一次观测到的地图/副本 id',
  `last_spell` int unsigned NOT NULL DEFAULT '0' COMMENT '最近一次观测到的 spell id',
  PRIMARY KEY (`entry`,`kind`),

  KEY `idx_last_seen` (`last_seen`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci COMMENT='playerbot 观测到的怪读条（治疗/控制），用于威胁等级自适应；人工名单见 ai_playerbot_priority_target'

ai_playerbot_pull_log.ddl:
CREATE TABLE `ai_playerbot_pull_log` (
  `id` bigint unsigned NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `map` smallint unsigned NOT NULL COMMENT '地图/副本 id',
  `instance_id` int unsigned NOT NULL DEFAULT '0' COMMENT '副本实例 id（= 一轮副本）',
  `seq` smallint unsigned NOT NULL DEFAULT '0' COMMENT '本轮第几次拉怪，从 1 开始',
  `ord` smallint unsigned NOT NULL DEFAULT '0' COMMENT '波次（= dungeon_route.ord；0 = boss 阶段/不在路线表）',
  `target_guid` int unsigned NOT NULL DEFAULT '0' COMMENT '第一次拉的目标 spawn guid',
  `target_entry` int unsigned NOT NULL DEFAULT '0' COMMENT '目标 entry',
  `tank_guid` int unsigned NOT NULL DEFAULT '0' COMMENT '记录者/队长 guid：真人组=队长；单人=自己；bot 路线=驱动坦克',
  `group_id` int unsigned NOT NULL DEFAULT '0' COMMENT '队伍 id（0 = 单人）',
  `source` enum('player','bot') NOT NULL DEFAULT 'player' COMMENT 'player = 队里有真人；bot = 纯机器人队',
  `members` tinyint unsigned NOT NULL DEFAULT '0' COMMENT '开拉时在本里的队伍人数',
  `started_at` int unsigned NOT NULL DEFAULT '0' COMMENT '开拉 unix 时间',
  `ended_at` int unsigned NOT NULL DEFAULT '0' COMMENT '结束 unix 时间（0 = 还没结束）',
  `duration_s` smallint unsigned NOT NULL DEFAULT '0' COMMENT '持续秒数',
  `result` varchar(16) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending' COMMENT 'pending/cleared/skipped/died/left',
  `mobs_total` smallint unsigned NOT NULL DEFAULT '0' COMMENT '开拉时这波还活着几只',
  `mobs_alive` smallint unsigned NOT NULL DEFAULT '0' COMMENT '结束时还剩几只',
  `deaths` tinyint unsigned NOT NULL DEFAULT '0' COMMENT '本次拉怪期间队伍死亡人数',
  `target_x` float NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
  `target_y` float NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
  `target_z` float NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
  `spawn_group_id` int unsigned NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `uk_run_seq_leader` (`map`,`instance_id`,`tank_guid`,`seq`),
  KEY `idx_map_ord` (`map`,`ord`),
  KEY `idx_started` (`started_at`),
  KEY `idx_started_at` (`started_at`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci ROW_FORMAT=DYNAMIC COMMENT='每轮副本的拉怪顺序与每次拉怪的结果（playerbot 引擎自动写入，勿手改）'
